instruction:
Fix `plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. CI=1 yarn backstage-cli repo test plugins/catalog/src/components/EntityLayout/EntityLayout.test.tsx timed out after 180s with React 'Maximum update depth' / checkForNestedUpdates warnings, stack: dispatchSetState <- react-router setStateImpl <- navigate (components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts:92:7) <- commitHookEffectListMount. Cause: the former-ref redirect useEffect calls navigate(targetUrl, {replace: true, state: {...location.state, redirectedFrom}}) whenever value.entity && value.redirectedFrom are set; after the navigation the route params already point at the target entity but `value` is still the old async result (redirectedFrom set), and the new location.state object re-triggers the effect, so it navigates again forever. Fix: only navigate when the current URL params still equal the requested former ref, i.e. guard with `value.redirectedFrom === stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name })` (compare normalized/lowercased refs), and do not include location.state in a way that re-fires after the redirect. Keep the existing behaviour: direct hits never redirect; sub-path, search and hash are preserved; state.redirectedFrom is passed for the notice.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
